A person's arm and phone briefly enter the frame at the bottom, pointing toward the chaos. (2) The camera stabilizes on a black leather sofa. A man in a grey sweatshirt and a woman in a brown sweater are kneeling on or near the sofa, each embracing one of the white dogs. The man hugs the dog tightly with both arms while the woman pets the other's head and neck. The room is lit with warm indoor lighting, highlighting the protective posture of the humans. (3) A close-up shot focused on one white dog's head and chest. A hand is seen stroking the dog's soft white fur and neck area rhythmically. The dog has a serious, somewhat fearful or dazed expression, looking away from the camera. The background shows a white shelving unit and thick curtains in the living room context.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with loud, chaotic rattling and thudding sounds of household objects shaking violently during an earthquake. A female voice screams 'Oh my god!' with very high pitch and intense emotional arousal. The sound of rapid handheld movement and audible breathiness is evident as the primary acoustic signal, momentarily masking all other environmental sounds. (2) The rattling noise subsides as the tremor ends. The female voice, now lower in pitch but still noticeably shaky and strained, says '嚇死我了' and '好恐怖' in an anxious tone. A calm, moderate-volume male voice enters the recording, saying '沒事吼' repeatedly to provide immediate comfort to the pets. (3) The male voice dominates the final phase, maintaining a low-pitched, friendly, and soothing professional narrative tone. He repeatedly whispers the dog's name 'Ponky' followed by '沒事沒事' in a rhythmic manner. Background ambient noise is minimal, characterized by clean studio-like indoor silence that allows for clear articulation of the comforting vocal phrases directed at the animals.
